scope.description: Whether the shown settings apply to all sites or to one specific site.

warning.description: Warning shown at the top of the topic, e.g. for internal developer settings.

global_settings_variable.description: A configuration variable with its value in the three layers: the factory value, the global layer, and a site's own layer. The page's scope decides which layers are shown.

factory_value.description: The built-in value, in effect wherever no layer configures one.

current.description: The variable as the page's scope sees it: the value in effect there, whether the scope configures it itself, and what that scope shows besides. Its type always equals the type of the app's scope.

hints.description: Notes shown above the form of the setting.

global_scope_value.description: What the global settings page shows and edits.

value.description: The value in effect for the installation.

explicit.description: Whether the installation configures the value itself instead of leaving it at the factory value. True even when the configured value equals the factory value.

site_overrides.description: Sites that configure the variable themselves and thereby override this value.

site_scope_value.description: What the site-specific settings page shows and edits.

value.description: The value in effect for the site.

explicit.description: Whether the site configures the value itself instead of inheriting the global layer. True even when the configured value equals the inherited one.

global_layer_value.description: The global layer as a site sees it: what the site inherits unless it configures the variable itself.

value.description: The value in effect for the installation.

explicit.description: Whether the installation configures the value itself instead of leaving it at the factory value.

text.description: Trusted HTML, sanitized to the allow-list of packages/cmk-web/cmk/web/utils/escaping.py.

copyable.description: Value shown verbatim behind the text, with a control that copies it.

url.description: Link to the site-specific global settings page.
